jobs.title: Sales Director
jobs.description_text:
p(X) provides aggregated, institutional-grade digital asset liquidity through a curated network of global trading venues. In today's highly fragmented market, counterparties that trade directly with p(X) gain access to deep, diversified liquidity while simplifying execution and settlement. This eliminates the operational burden of establishing and maintaining separate relationships with multiple liquidity providers while at the same time allowing for superior execution quality.
p(X) operates as an independent business unit, separate from the Talos Platform business, governed by its own AML, compliance, risk management, and operational frameworks designed to meet the requirements of a regulated trading and liquidity provisioning business.
As a distinct legal entity, p(X) maintains its own balance sheet, counterparty onboarding processes, governance structure, and Board of Directors. While p(X) leverages certain shared corporate services — including Legal, Compliance, Finance, and Information Security — it operates independently from Talos, with its own management and staff, in all core commercial and operational activities.
We are hiring a Sales Lead/Director to drive counterparty acquisition, onboarding, and revenue growth for our p(X) liquidity provision business. This is a high-ownership, early-employee role responsible for generating leads, building strong counterparty relationships, and closing deals to support a fast-scaling pipeline.
The ideal candidate has exceptional communication skills, a proactive, problem-solving mindset, and a deep understanding of crypto institutional sales & trading workflows.
Responsibilities
Source, pitch, and close new counterparties (retail brokers, fintechs, funds, neobanks)
Own the full sales lifecycle: prospecting → negotiation → onboarding → activation
Expand our network of trading counterparties and products throughout 2027
Build and maintain long-term strategic counterparty relationships
Meet and exceed agreed-upon sales and activation targets.
Partner closely with Trading on onboarding, pricing, connectivity, and workflow improvements
Analyze market opportunities, track pipeline status, and produce clear sales reporting
Qualifications
7-10+ years in institutional trading sales (some overlap with crypto will be a bonus), with proven revenue-carrying responsibility
Strong background in institutional capital markets with demonstrable sales achievements
Existing crypto network or prior experience successfully growing a book of business in the ecosystem
Highly motivated and target-driven, with a track record of hitting or exceeding goals
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills
Data-driven approach to prioritization and decision-making
High sense of urgency, entrepreneurial mindset, and ability to operate autonomously

jobs.title: Manager: Compliance Advisory and Data Protection
jobs.location: London or remote within the UK
jobs.description_text:
About Griffin
Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.
We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.
We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.
Learn more about what we do
Our culture
We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.
We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work 
and
 home life.
We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.
Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.
Learn more about our culture.
The Team
You'll join our Service guild and work across first line operations, sales and produt. Working closely with Protect (our second line) you'll be the first person dedicated to compliance within the team. You'll define what great compliance solutions look like. Then implement them , keeping Griffin's products and customer outcomes in shape as we grow.
The opportunity
We want compliance and data protection built into how we design, sell and run our products. As our hands on DPO and compliance adviser, in the first line (the teams who run the business and own its risks), you'll bring regulatory expertise to help our operations, commercial and product teams do exactly that. With card issuing and other launches coming up, there's plenty to get stuck into.
What success looks like
In your first year, you’ve taken ownership of our data protection agenda. You’ve gone looking for ways to improve, made the changes happen, and given our senior leaders an honest picture of where we stand. You’ve sought out our operations, sales and product teams and shown them that working with you makes things smoother, not slower. Now they bring you in early by default. You’ve guided at least one major launch, like card issuing, from first idea to go live. And you’ve put clear governance and outcome monitoring in place for our live products, so Protect (our second line risk and compliance team) sees fewer surprises and finds a stronger compliance foundation.
To do this you'll be involved in:
Product development:
 turning regulation into clear requirements, customer journeys, T&Cs and fair value assessments, from first idea through product approval to launch, with data protection built in from the start.
Product lifecycle management:
 keeping live products compliant through periodic fair value assessments, outcome monitoring, reviews, changes and closures.
Sales:
 helping our commercial team check early whether potential partners fit our risk appetite, and reviewing sales material.
Marketing:
 working on marketing materials, both ours and our customers’, to make sure they comply with regulation and our own policies, and that our financial promotions are properly challenged.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description_text:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll fill a key role in acquiring new customers and creating raving fans. Being a champion of the entire sales process from start to finish, you will use your creative prospecting skills to strategically pursue net new business. Working through complex deals, your insatiable curiosity makes you a thought leader, and your drive to succeed keeps you at the top of the leaderboard. Out-of-the-box thinkers and those who will never settle for the status quo are strongly encouraged to apply!

As a part of Gong’s sales team, you will become a master of discovery & a strategic business partner for prospective customers. You will play a huge role in our company's growth while navigating your own individual growth journey as well. Are you looking for the opportunity to make big waves & to perfect your craft of sales? We can’t wait to meet you!

RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Manage enterprise prospects from lead to close.
  • Provide an exceptional customer experience.
  • Provide timely and accurate forecasts while managing a pipeline.
  • Represent the voice of the customer to cross-functional partners in efforts to drive continuous improvement.
  • Clearly articulate and demonstrate our value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects.
  • Comfortable and energized operating and problem-solving in a fast-moving organization, working inbound and outbound opportunities across a range of industries and company size.
  • Exceed Quota.
QUALIFICATIONS 
  • 3+ years of selling SaaS and enterprise software across multiple industries across EMEA to Enterprise prospects and customers
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with professional fluency in English.
  • Creative, resourceful, detail-oriented, and well-organised.
  • A strong team player but still a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment.
YOU ARE
  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment
  • Possess and are driven by a hunting mindset
  • Passionate about providing exceptional customer experiences
  • Creative, resourceful, detail-oriented, and well-organized
  • Experienced in selling transformation/visionary solutions, especially where there isn't an obvious budget (demand creation vs. fulfilment)
  • Comfortable leading technical presentation/demo and owning full customer lifecycle from prospect to close
  • A team player with high integrity and grit
PERKS & BENEFITS 
  • We offer Gongsters a variety of private health insurance plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs.
  • Wellbe

Enterprise Revenue Architects at Gong are strategic partners to our largest customers. Focused on driving revenue transformation from Gong’s AI Operating System.   • Passion for driving customer centricity by leveraging internal stakeholders such as Sales, Product, Support, Marketing and executives
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Data-driven mindset with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Passion for driving customer outcomes and contributing to a high performing and accountable work culture
  • Our RAs are self-starters who excel in high paced environments and thrive in change and ambiguity. Our top performers have a growth mindset and pride themselves in being coachable. We are a team that values collaboration and winning together, enjoying the ride, and challenging conventional wisdom. If that’s you too, we want to hear from you!

jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

In this role, you'll develop and deliver a scale customer onboarding experience for a high volume of customers in our commercial segments. You'll work closely with leadership to help design what scale onboarding can look like at Figma and expand our programs to support international sales teams. You will collaborate with other members of the Customer Onboarding team to inform and evolve the processes and materials for this program. Also, you will use metrics, customer feedback and direct experience to help identify new initiatives and materials needed to better engage and support our customers. You are an excellent communicator and project manager with a passion for customers and we can't wait to meet you!

This is a full time role based in London.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Own and manage scale customer onboarding programs supporting a high volume of commercial customers
  • Partner closely with sales, marketing and enablement teams to develop and evangelize the program within the Figma organization
  • Guide customer goals and successfully drive a high volume of customers towards onboarding closeout
  • Partner with Marketing, Operations and Sales to build and optimize scalable customer programs
  • Report on metrics and customer feedback to assess the impact of successful onboarding and to help identify new customer initiatives and product opportunities
  • Develop content and enablement resources for customers to use for training/education and to help accelerate product adoption
  • Consult on product and industry best practices to act as a trusted advisor across a high-volume book of customers, inspiring new use cases for the product

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 4+ years of relevant work experience, ideally in B2B SaaS
  • Experience managing customers through onboarding or implementation of technical products
  • Experience working with many customers at one time and demonstrated ability to drive towards successful customer outcomes t

As a Recruiting Manager you will cultivate, lead, mentor, grow, and hire a team of recruiting professionals supporting multiple business functions across Sales in EMEA. You will work from conception to fruition on staffing strategies to support these organizations and partner with our hiring leaders to execute top of class recruiting practices. Figma's continued future success relies heavily on the ability to scale and the talent acquisition team is at the helm of the ship.

This is a full time role that will be based in our London Hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a growing team of recruiters
  • Collaborate with Sales leadership to understand business needs and align recruiting resources accordingly in order to achieve goals
  • Partner with recruiting leaders to develop a talent brand strategy that continues to bring in exceptional talent to Figma and showcases the incredible culture
  • Create and implement a team structure that optimizes for efficiency and scale
  • Champion, partner, and execute on various initiatives relating to inclusion and diversity
  • Build and improve upon recruiting best practices across all orgs

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience in a fast-paced, competitive environment, including 2+ years of people management experience and demonstrated expertise in SaaS sales recruiting
  • Proven experience partnering with stakeholders, senior leaders, and executives to develop and drive effective recruiting strategies and initiatives
  • Strong ability to leverage data to measure team performance, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and tell compelling stories that inform decision-making
  • Experience building and scaling recruiting functions, processes, and programs to support sustained organizational growth

While it's not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience with diversity and inclusion as it relates to recruiting strategy and activity
  • Ability to take a blank canvas in an ambiguous environment and create something incredible

jobs.title: Sales Director, EMEA
jobs.description_text:
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.
At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.
We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.
 
Sales Director, EMEA
 
This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading.
 
As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success.
 
Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing.
 
Responsibilities
 
Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers.
Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one.
Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities.
Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition.
Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships.
Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable.
Capture and communicate client and market insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.
Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.
Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events.
Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team.
 
Requirements
 
7+ years of client-facing sales or commercial experience within institutional financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS serving capital markets.
An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe.
A proven track record of originating and closing new business, with quantifiable results.
Deep understanding of TradFi market structure and institutional trading workflows. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued.
